context:
Goal: after you Post a card in Card in Hand, the next card starts with a clean match list.
Problem (rule): on item 48 you ruled "After a tap on a match, the list holds: every row keeps its place until the next keystroke." PR 235 also ends that hold when a Post saves, as New envelope and Close already do. That goes past the words of your ruling, so it needs your word.
Based on (measured): CI run 42677685979 on PR 235 is green; the four Post tests pass on the first try, and the design review passes (no match rows on the left page after Post; the receipt keeps the Post slot).
Based on (read): what the ruling protects, no row sliding under your finger after a tap, still holds, because the list clears only after the Post press.
Departs from: main's duo-card-in-hand, where the hold ends only at the next keystroke — the hold also ends at a saved Post, New envelope or Close.
Meanwhile: the lane waits on this before hand-off; nothing else waits.
holds: Lane duo-post-pins (PR 235) waits on this before it hands off to the batch runner.

options.gain: The next card starts with a clean list, and the record matches the code.
options.how: The ruling's sentence becomes "...until the next keystroke, a saved Post, New envelope or Close." PR 235 ships as built.
options.label: A saved Post clears the held rows

options.gain: Your ruling stays word for word.
options.how: PR 235 drops the Post clear; the held rows stay until the next keystroke.
options.label: Keep the ruling as written
options.lose: The last card's held rows still show after Post, until you type the next card.

ref: decision duo-card-in-hand (Card in Hand on the iPhone Duo); item 48 duo-tap-shift-check (the match list holds after a tap); PR 235 (lane duo-post-pins, Post pins on Card in Hand)
title: After a saved Post on Card in Hand, should the held match rows clear, so the next card starts with a clean list?
why: The clear comes after the Post press, so nothing moves under your finger, and the next card starts clean.
